clients.name: Reeve backend
clients.description: Service account the backend uses to read organisations, roles and modules

clientScopes.name: kc-admin-api
clientScopes.description: Grants access to the Keycloak Admin REST API by adding its required audience to the token

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token

realm.name: org_member
realm.description: Member of the organisation: organisation details and settings, read-only. Assigned on the organisation group, so every member has it.

realm.name: org_admin
realm.description: Edit the organisation details and currencies.

realm.name: transactions_viewer
realm.description: Transactions module: transactions, batches, reconciliation status, data explorer, setup data, read-only.

realm.name: transactions_setup
realm.description: Transactions module: configure chart of accounts, event/reference codes, cost centers, project codes, VAT codes, currencies; import/export setup data.

realm.name: transactions_erp
realm.description: Transactions module: configure the ERP (NetSuite) connection.

realm.name: transactions_importer
realm.description: Transactions module: import/extract from the ERP and reprocess batches.

realm.name: transactions_reviewer
realm.description: Transactions module: review (approve/reject) transactions.

realm.name: transactions_reconciler
realm.description: Transactions module: run the reconciliation.

realm.name: transactions_publisher
realm.description: Transactions module: publish (approve/reject) transactions.

realm.name: transactions_publish_viewer
realm.description: Transactions: see the publish queue, without approving anything

realm.name: transactions_dashboard_editor
realm.description: Transactions: create and edit data explorer dashboards

realm.name: reports_viewer
realm.description: Reporting module: reports, templates, chart of accounts and accounting regimes, read-only.

realm.name: reports_setup
realm.description: Reporting module: configure accounting regimes and report type field mappings.

realm.name: reports_editor
realm.description: Reporting module: create, edit, generate and delete reports and report templates.

realm.name: reports_publisher
realm.description: Reporting module: publish/reject reports.

realm.name: reports_publish_viewer
realm.description: Reporting: see the publish queue, without approving anything

realm.name: document_vault_viewer
realm.description: Document vault module: documents, keys, recipients and contacts, read-only.

realm.name: document_vault_editor
realm.description: Document vault module: upload documents, manage keys and contacts, delete own drafts.

realm.name: document_vault_publisher
realm.description: Document vault module: publish documents on-chain and attest them with KERI.

realm.name: document_vault_admin
realm.description: Document vault module: delete keys and draft documents of other users.

realm.name: funding_viewer
realm.description: Funding module: projects and spending events, read-only (plus the VAT codes and currencies they use).

realm.name: funding_setup
realm.description: Funding module: create and edit the VAT codes and currencies the funding module uses.

realm.name: funding_project_manager
realm.description: Funding module: create, edit and delete projects and milestones, bulk import; delete events.

realm.name: funding_event_editor
realm.description: Funding module: create and edit spending events.

realm.name: funding_publisher
realm.description: Funding module: publish spending events.

realm.name: platform_admin
realm.description: Platform administrator: creates organisations.
